output.summary: The claim was denied because bariatric surgery is excluded except when a BMI ≥ 40 and a six‑month supervised weight‑loss program are documented (Section 7.4, V2025). The member has only a BMI record; the required supervised program record is missing. Prior V2025 cases (HC‑025, HC‑024) were overturned when both pieces of evidence were submitted. An appeal is viable after providing the missing program record.
